property_summary: After calling Collect(uint256), the locked state variable must be false.
After a Collect call succeeds, the account balance remains unchanged if the caller has insufficient balance or the unlock time hasn't been reached.
The locked state variable must be false after any Collect(uint256) call, regardless of revert or success.
